The body Status section stays Accepted. This is not an NDS backward skip: accepted was never a schema status. The three edits are the unquoted version line, the status line, and the inserted entry. That is the spec glob docs/nips/*.md: this directory only, not a nested file. The three files at <A> are all direct children. check_c1_frontmatter_schema and check_c2_format receive c1_c2_md. C3, C5, C8, C9, and C10 keep shipped_md. build_shipped_md_set and build_payload_md_set are not edited. --payload does not reach this branch. --target is not edited: a NIP passed as --target still gets C9 and C10, and NIP-0001 and NIP-0003 still fail C9 that way.

design_decisions.banners: The failure banners stay exactly [C1] FAIL frontmatter-schema and [C2] FAIL format. AT2's regex ^[C1] FAIL would also match a different check that printed [C1] FAIL. check_c1_frontmatter_schema "${shipped_md[@]}" && passed=$((passed + 1)) || failed=$((failed + 1))
    check_c2_format "${shipped_md[@]}" && passed=$((passed + 1)) || failed=$((failed + 1))
pinned_interface.call_new:
# Default sweep only (phase-014 feature 107, NDEBT-044 b): C1 and C2 also
    # read every docs/nips/*.md (this directory only, not nested). Those files
    # stay out of the shipped-doc set, so C3, C5, C8, C9, and C10 keep the
    # shipped_md list, and --payload never reaches this branch. --target is

    local c1_c2_md=("${shipped_md[@]}")
    if [ -d docs/nips ]; then
      while IFS= read -r f; do
        c1_c2_md+=("${f}")
      done < <(find docs/nips -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.md' | LC_ALL=C sort)
    fi

    check_c1_frontmatter_schema "${c1_c2_md[@]}" && passed=$((passed + 1)) || failed=$((failed + 1))
    check_c2_format "${c1_c2_md[@]}" && passed=$((passed + 1)) || failed=$((failed + 1))

design_notes.serialization: Do not run tools/validate.sh and tools/fixtures_self_test.sh at the same time, in this tree or in one scratch copy. S05 starts with a /proc refusal (exit 4) and then runs its seven scratch cases one at a time. scratch_run copies the tree and does not write the real tree. Do not take a scratch copy while either script is running in the source tree. AT2 and AT3 are themselves scratch_run invocations of validate.sh; do not overlap them with AT5, AT6, or S05.
hazards: 1. NDEBT-047, not fixed and not touched. tools/fixtures_self_test.sh stays byte-identical. Do not install a trap and do not add a fixture. The self-test still swaps tools/skill.json inside test_c13 with no EXIT backstop. This feature does not call that swap except by running the existing self-test as AT6, one process, not overlapped with validate.sh.

2. AT2's [C2] FAIL is expected after implementation. status accepted fails the schema (C1) and C2's own enum test. Do not suppress C2. S05 case 2 is the control: with the C1 echo silenced, [C1] FAIL is gone and [C2] FAIL remains.

3. AT3 goes vacuous if the schema is tightened to reject a foreign authoritative_source, or if C1 is made to fail whenever C2 fails. The schema is not edited. S05 case 4 is the control: with the C2 echo silenced, the AT3 mutation exits 0.

4. Adding docs/nips/ to build_shipped_md_set or build_payload_md_set fails S04 and, for the shipped set, would fail the default sweep on C9 (NIP-0001's three missing schema paths and NIP-0003's four missing paths). Do not 'fix' those bodies. Proposals cite paths that do not exist yet.
5. --target is unchanged. Do not special-case a NIP to skip C9. The feature widens only the default sweep's C1 and C2 inputs.

6. The string 'status: active' must occur once in NIP-0002 after the edit, and the change_log summary must not contain that substring. S05 case 5 replaces that one occurrence back to accepted. NIP-0001's one 'status: active' is the AT2 needle and that file is not edited.
7. Evidence files: line 1 is the invocation, the body is raw output, the last line is EXIT:<code> from the process. No '| tee' and no '| grep' on a capture.

8. The untracked .nizam/ directory in the shared tree is not part of this feature. git worktree add does not copy it. Do not add it, and do not run S03 in a tree where it is untracked. S03 would treat it as a path outside scope.

9. C9 extracts slash-qualified path tokens that end in md, json, sh, html, or yml. The pinned README row and the help additions do not add a new one. The NIP-0002 change_log summary names schema/frontmatter.schema.json, which exists, and C9 does not scan docs/nips/ in the default sweep anyway.

10. Do not edit the C5 paragraph, the Payload-doc set paragraph, or the --payload option paragraph (NDEBT-045). Feature 108 owns the C5 text and the Payload-doc set paragraph. Do not edit the Shipped-doc set paragraph either: it must keep describing the set those other checks use, and docs/nips/ is not in that set.

            continue

            argv = [part.decode() for part in open("/proc/%s/cmdline" % name, "rb").read().split(b"\0") if part]
            cwd = os.readlink("/proc/%s/cwd" % name)

            continue

serial_guard()
pins = json.load(open(".agent/contracts/107.json"))["design_notes"]["pinned_interface"]

def mutate(rel, old, new):
    return (
        "p = root / {rel!r}\n"
        "t = p.read_text()\n"
        "old = {old!r}\n"
        "new = {new!r}\n"
        "assert t.count(old) == 1, t.count(old)\n"
        "p.write_text(t.replace(old, new, 1))\n"
    ).format(rel=rel, old=old, new=new)

def append_suffix(rel, suffix):
    return (
        "p = root / {rel!r}\n"
        "t = p.read_text()\n"
        "suffix = {suffix!r}\n"
        "assert suffix not in t\n"
        "p.write_text(t + suffix)\n"

     [r"^\[C2\] FAIL format$", pins["c2_source_detail"], r"^\[C1\] PASS frontmatter-schema$"],
     [r"^\[C1\] FAIL"], VAL),
    ("silencing the C2 fail echo removes [C2] FAIL from the AT3 mutation; C1 stays passing",
     ["--replace", NIP1, "authoritative_source: docs/nips/NIP-0001-ecosystem-engineering-cycle.md", "authoritative_source: docs/nips/NIP-0001-moved.md", "--py-mutate", ablate_c2], 0,
     [r"^\[C1\] PASS frontmatter-schema$", r"^\[C2\] PASS format$", r"^SUMMARY: 16 passed, 0 failed$"],
     [r"^\[C1\] FAIL", r"^\[C2\] FAIL"], VAL),

    ("a bare fence and a missing path in a NIP body do not fail C3, C9, or C10",
